title: Warm Spiced Greek Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek dish featuring lamb, blackcurrant jam, and a blend of warming spices, simmered to perfection in a copper pot. This stew is not only delicious but also packed with anti-inflammatory properties.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the ground cumin, coriander, and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Add the blackcurrant jam, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the bay leaves and serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
